blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Online misinformation increasingly appears in spoken formats such as news clips, podcasts, interviews, political speeches, and social media videos, creating a need for fact-checking systems that can verify claims directly from speech. We introduce VeriSpeak , a probe benchmark for studying speech-based fact verification in Large Audio Language Models (LALMs). VeriSpeak contains 3,879 spoken claims spanning temporal, geographical, and relational facts, with balanced true and false labels. The benchmark is designed to examine whether factual verification ability transfers from text to speech, and whether retrieval-augmented LALMs can use textual evidence to correctly support or refute spoken claims. Our experiments reveal a consistent text-speech modality gap: LALMs that verify written claims reliably often fail on the same claims when spoken. Moreover, retrieval alone provides limited gains because models frequently conflate retrieved evidence with the spoken claim. In contrast, retrieval combined with explicit reasoning improves claim-evidence comparison, with a thinking-tuned LALM reaching 86.1% accuracy. VeriSpeak highlights that effective speech misinformation detection requires not only speech understanding, but also grounded reasoning over retrieved evidence.
The dataset is publicly available via Hugging Face at https://huggingface.co/datasets/abhiram4572/VeriSpeak .

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Spoken media, from news and podcasts to speeches and social videos, often conveys factual claims that may be true, false, outdated, or misleading 1 1 1 https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2025 . As Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) become increasingly capable of following instructions over speech and audio, they create new opportunities for spoken fact-checking, misinformation detection, and voice-based content moderation Chu et al. (2023) ; Chu et al. (2024) ; Kong et al. (2024) ; Ghosh et al. (2025) ; Abouelenin et al. (2025) . These applications require more than speech recognition: models must identify the spoken claim and judge its factuality.
blocks.zh: 流言蜚语的媒体,从新闻和播客到演讲和社会视频,经常传达可能真实的,虚假的,过时的,或误导的 11 1 https://reutersinstitut.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2025 。 。 。 随着大型音频语言模型(LALMs)越来越有能力在语音和音频上遵循指令,它们为语音事实检查、错误信息检测和语音内容节制Chu等人(2023年);Chu等人(2024年);Kong等人(2024年);Ghosh等人(2025年);Abouellenin等人(2025年)。 这些申请要求的不仅仅是语音识别:模型必须识别口头诉求并判断其真实性.

blocks.en:
Fact verification is commonly formulated as evidence-based claim verification where a system retrieves evidence and predicts whether a claim is supported or refuted Thorne et al. (2018) ; Jiang et al. (2020) ; Wadden et al. (2020) ; Aly et al. (2021) ; Mamta and Cocarascu (2025) . This retrieve-and-verify paradigm also underlies retrieval-augmented Large Language Models (LLM) methods for knowledge-intensive generation and verification Lewis et al. (2020) ; Asai et al. (2024) . Multimodal fact-checking further studies cases where information is distributed across modalities, especially in image-text misinformation settings Mishra et al. (2022) ; Yao et al. (2023) ; Akhtar et al. (2023) ; Khaliq et al. (2024) .
In contrast, speech fact verification poses a distinct cross-modal setting: the claim is acoustic, while the supporting evidence is textual. The model must therefore preserve the spoken claim as the verification target while reasoning over retrieved text.
blocks.zh:
事实核实通常被表述为基于证据的索赔核实,即一个系统检索证据,并预测索恩等人(2018年);江等人(2020年);瓦登等人(2020年);阿利等人(2021年);马姆塔和科卡拉斯库(2025年)是否支持或反驳索赔。 这种检索和核实的范式也为检索和验证知识密集型生成和验证Lewis等人(2020年)的大型语言模型(LLM)方法提供了依据;Asai等人(2024年)。 多种模式的事实检查进一步研究了信息在各种模式中分布的案例,特别是在图像文本错误信息设置Mishra等人(2022年);姚等人(2023年);Akhtar等人(2023年);Khaliq等人(2024年)。
与此相反,语音事实核实提出了一种独特的交叉模式:索赔是声学性的,而支持证据是文字性的。 因此,模型必须保留口头主张作为核查目标,同时对检索的案文进行推理。

blocks.en: This raises a broader question: Can LALMs perform evidence-grounded fact verification when the claim is spoken? Although many LALMs are built on pretrained LLM backbones, speech-based verification requires more than accessing factual knowledge from text-trained parameters: the model must identify the spoken claim, use retrieved textual evidence, and compare the two to classify the claim. Prior work on modality gaps shows that models can behave differently across modalities even when the semantic content is similar ( Yi et al., 2024 ; Kwon et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ; Xiang et al., 2025 ) ; here, such gaps may affect both spoken-claim understanding and evidence use.
blocks.zh: 这就提出了一个更广泛的问题: LALMs在审理索赔时能否进行有证据依据的事实核实? 虽然许多LALM是建立在经过预先训练的LLM主干线上,但基于语音的核查需要的不仅仅是从经过文字训练的参数中获得事实知识:模型必须识别口头索赔,使用检索的文字证据,并且比较两者来对索赔进行分类. 以往关于模式差距的研究表明,即使语义内容相似,模型也会在模式中采取不同的行为(Yi等人,2024年;Kwon等人,2025年;Deng等人,2025年;Xiang等人,2025年);在这方面,这种差距可能影响对口头申诉的理解和证据的使用。

blocks.en: To investigate this systematically, we introduce VeriSpeak , a benchmark of 3,879 spoken claims spanning temporal, geographical, and relational facts, with balanced correct and incorrect labels. Its design enables controlled comparisons across text-only verification, text-input LALMs, speech-input LALMs, retrieval-augmented verification, and reasoning-augmented verification.
blocks.zh: 为了系统地调查这一点,我们引入了Verispeak(Verispeak)这一基准,它包含3,879项口头申诉,涉及时间、地域和关系事实,并有平衡的正确和不正确的标签。 其设计使得能够在文本唯一核查、文本输入LALMs、语音输入LALMs、检索验证和推理验证之间进行有控制的比较。

blocks.en: Using VeriSpeak , we systematically evaluate five LALMs Chu et al. (2023) ; Chu et al. (2024) ; Ghosh et al. (2025) ; Ghosh et al. (2026) ; Abouelenin et al. (2025) across three model families under text, speech, retrieval, and reasoning settings. Specifically, we investigate: (i) whether text-based factual verification ability transfers to spoken claims , (ii) where the text–speech modality gap arises and whether retrieval can compensate for it , (iii) how transcript-based retrieval compares with direct audio-query retrieval , and (iv) when explicit reasoning helps LALMs use retrieved evidence .
blocks.zh: 使用Verispeak,我们系统地评价了五个LALMs Chu等人(2023年)、Chu等人(2024年)、Ghosh等人(2025年)、Ghosh等人(2026年)、Abouellenin等人(2025年)在文字、演讲、检索和推理环境下的三个模范家庭。 具体地说,我们调查:(一) 是否基于文本的事实核实能力转移到口头索赔;(二) 文本-语音模式差距发生之处以及检索是否能够弥补这一差距;(三) 基于记录的检索如何与直接的音频-query检索相比较;(四) 当明确推理有助于LALMs使用检索的证据时。

blocks.en: Our findings include: (i) LALMs exhibit a large and consistent text-speech modality gap: factual verification ability observed on textual claims does not reliably transfer to spoken claims, even when the same LALM remains strong on text inputs. (ii) Retrieval alone only partially improves speech fact verification. Transcript-based RAG is generally more reliable than audio-query RAG, but standard LALMs often conflate the spoken claim with retrieved evidence, treating the evidence itself as the statement to verify. (iii) Reasoning helps mainly when evidence is available. Chain-of-thought prompting alone does not reliably improve standard speech-only verification, but RAG with explicit reasoning improves claim-evidence comparison. A thinking-tuned LALM benefits most strongly, reaching 86.1% accuracy with retrieval and reasoning. Figure 1 summarizes these settings and illustrates the main claim-evidence conflation failure mode.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果包括:(一) LALM在文字表达方式上存在巨大和一致的空白:在文字主张上观察到的事实核实能力不能可靠地转移到口头主张上,即使同样的LALM在文字投入上仍然很强. (二) 仅检索仅能部分改进语音事实核查。 基于语录的RAG一般比音频清音的RAG更可靠,但标准的LALMs经常将口述的主张与检索的证据混为一谈,把证据本身当作声明来核实. (三) 理由主要在有证据时有帮助。 单靠思维链促进并不能可靠地改进标准单词核查,但有明确推理的RAG改进了权利主张与证据的比较. 一个经过思维调整的LALM最有利,在检索和推理方面达到86.1%的准确度. 图1概述了这些设置,并说明了索赔-证据合并的主要失败模式。

blocks.en: Overall, VeriSpeak provides a controlled testbed for analyzing LALM fact verification across text, speech, retrieval, and reasoning settings. Our results show that spoken fact verification requires not only speech recognition and evidence retrieval, but also robust claim-evidence separation.
blocks.zh: 总体来说,Verispeak提供了一个可控测试台,用于分析跨文本、语音、检索和推理设置的LALM事实验证。 我们的结果显示,口述事实的核实不仅需要言语识别和证据检索,而且需要强有力的权利要求与证据分离。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Fact Verification. Fact verification has long relied on retrieval-augmented verification: a system first retrieves relevant evidence and then uses it to verify a claim. Benchmarks such as FEVER Thorne et al. (2018) , HoVer Jiang et al. (2020) , SciFact Wadden et al. (2020) , and FEVEROUS Aly et al. (2021) instantiate this broad retrieve-and-verify paradigm across diverse inputs. While retrieval modules vary from sparse retrieval to dense neural retrieval, performance depends on two factors: whether the system retrieves useful evidence, and whether the verifier can correctly leverage the retrieved evidence for verification. Modern RAG-style systems generalize this retrieve-and-condition paradigm to LLM-based generation, verification, revision, and critique Lewis et al. (2020) ; Asai et al. (2024) ; Gao et al. (2023) .
blocks.zh: 事实核实。 事实核查长期依赖检索验证:一个系统首先检索有关证据,然后用它核实索赔。 FEVER Thorne等人(2018年)、HoVer Jiang等人(2020年)、SciFact Wadden等人(2020年)和FEVEROUS Aly等人的基准。 (2021年)将这种广泛的检索和验证范式立即纳入各种投入。 虽然检索模块从稀少的检索到密集的神经检索各有不同,但性能取决于两个因素:系统是否检索有用的证据,以及核查者是否能够正确地利用所检索的证据进行核查. 现代的RAG式系统将这种检索和条件范式概括到基于LLM的生成、核实、修订和批评Lewis等人(2020年);Asai等人(2024年);Gao等人(2023年)。

blocks.en: Recent multimodal fact verification extends evidence-based verification beyond text, mainly to visual–text misinformation Yao et al. (2023) ; Mishra et al. (2022) ; Chakraborty et al. (2023) ; Akhtar et al. (2023) ; Khaliq et al. (2024) ; Kangur et al. (2025) . These works show that verification becomes harder when claims and evidence span modalities. Speech fact verification poses a distinct challenge: the claim is spoken, while the retrieved evidence is typically textual. We study this setting through a controlled benchmark, asking whether Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) can leverage retrieved textual evidence for spoken claims as reliably as text-only LLMs do for written claims.
blocks.zh: 近期的多式联运事实核查将基于证据的核查扩展到文本之外,主要是视觉文本错误信息 Yao等人(2023年);Mishra等人(2022年);Chakraborty等人(2023年);Akhtar等人(2023年);Khaliq等人(2024年);Kangur等人(2025年)。 这些工作表明,在索赔和证据涉及模式时,核查变得更加困难。 语音事实的核实构成一个明显的挑战:申诉是口头的,而检索的证据通常是文字的。 我们通过一个可控的基准来研究这一设定,询问大型音频语言模型(LALMs)是否能够像对书面索赔那样可靠地为口头索赔利用检索到的文本证据。

blocks.en: Large Audio Language Models. LALMs couple pretrained language models with speech or audio encoders, enabling models to follow instructions over spoken and non-speech audio inputs. Early systems such as Pengi Deshmukh et al. (2023) , LTU-AS Gong et al. (2023) , and SpeechGPT Zhang et al. (2023) showed that LLMs can be adapted to audio-conditioned interaction. Recent models, including AudioPaLM Rubenstein et al. (2023) , SALMONN Tang et al. (2024) , WavLLM Hu et al. (2024) , GAMA Ghosh et al. (2024) , MERaLiON-AudioLLM He et al. (2024) , Qwen-Audio Chu et al. (2023) , Qwen2-Audio Chu et al. (2024) , Audio-Flamingo Kong et al. (2024) , Audio-Flamingo-3 Ghosh et al. (2025) , and Phi-4-Multimodal Abouelenin et al. (2025) , further improve speech understanding, audio reasoning, and instruction following. However, these capabilities do not directly imply reliable factual verification. Speech fact verification requires a model to recover the claim from audio, preserve it as the target of verification, and reason over external textual evidence without conflating the two sources. Our work evaluates whether current LALMs can meet this requirement.
blocks.zh: 大型音频语言模型. LALMs将预训语言模型与语音或音频编码器结合,使模型在语音和非语音音频输入上能够遵循指令. 早期系统如Pengi Deshmukh等人(2023年)、LTU-AS Gong等人(2023年)和SpeechGPT 张等人(2023年)表示LLMS可以适应音频条件交互. 最近的模型包括AudioPALM Rubenstein等人(2023年)、SALMONN Tang等人(2024年)、WavLLLM。 胡等人(2024年),GAMA Ghosh等人(2024年),MERaLion-AudioLLM 他等人(2024年),Quen-Audio 朱等人 (2023年), Qune2-Audio Chu等人(2024年),Audio-Flamingo Kong等人(2024年),Audio-Flamingo-3 Ghosh等人(2025年),以及Phi-4-Multimodule Abouellenin等人案。 (2025),进一步提高语音理解,音频推理,以及后续指令. 然而,这些能力并不直接意味着可靠的事实核查。 语音事实核实需要一种模型,从音频中收回索赔,将其作为核实的目标,并且不将两种来源混为一谈,以外部文字证据为理由。 我们的工作评估了目前的LALM是否能够满足这一要求.

blocks.en: Multimodal Modality Gap. Prior work has shown that multimodal models can suffer from modality gaps and modality imbalance, where one modality is not used as reliably as another Yi et al. (2024) ; Kwon et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2025) . Similar issues arise in Large Audio/Speech Language Models: the same linguistic content can lead to different behavior depending on whether it is presented as text or speech Xiang et al. (2025) . Existing work mainly studies this problem through representation alignment, token-level matching, or cross-modal calibration Issam et al. (2025) ; Cuervo et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 多式联运 差距。 先前的工作表明,多式联运模式可能存在模式差距和模式不平衡,其中一种模式的使用不如另一种Yi等人(2024年);Kwon等人(2025年);Liu等人(2025年)可靠。 在大型音频/语音语言模型中也会出现类似的问题:相同的语言内容可以导致不同的行为,取决于它是否作为文本或语音Xiang et al. (2025). 现有工作主要通过表示校正、符号级配对或跨模式校准Issam等人(2025);Cuervo等人(2025)。

blocks.en: We study a complementary question: whether speech-capable models can perform evidence-grounded verification when the claim is spoken and the evidence is textual. In this setting, the model must maintain a clear separation between the spoken claim and retrieved evidence, then reason over both sources to decide veracity.
blocks.zh: 我们研究了一个补充性问题:在提出指控时,有语言能力的模型是否能够进行有证据根据的核查,而证据是文字上的。 在这种情况下,模型必须明确区分口头申诉和收回的证据,然后由两个来源来决定真实性。

blocks.en: 3 VeriSpeak: A Probe-Benchmark for Speech Fact Verification
blocks.zh: 3 VeriSpeak: 用于语音事实核查的测试-奔驰标记

blocks.en: To probe factual reasoning capabilities of LALMs in a controlled setting, we construct VeriSpeak through a systematic multi-stage pipeline that maintains strict control over data quality, label distribution, and category balance.
blocks.zh: 为了探索LALM在可控环境下的事实推理能力,我们通过一个系统化的多阶段管道构建Verispeak,对数据质量,标签分布和类别平衡保持严格的控制.

blocks.en:
Knowledge Base and Enrichment. We build on the knowledge base
of Shah et al. (2019) , which provides short free-text
celebrity biographies keyed by entity IDs, with the entity name appearing at the
start of each record. Using this name, we scrape
Wikipedia 2 2 2 https://www.wikipedia.org/ to enrich each biography with

normalization of historical country labels (e.g., “Kingdom of Great Britain” → \to “United Kingdom”).

qualitatively different knowledge types, letting us diagnose whether the

mentions by matching marital, parental, and sibling keywords ( married , spouse , wife/husband , son/daughter of , father/mother of , brother/sister of ) at the sentence level.

Atomic Fact Extraction. To ensure model errors reflect reasoning
failures rather than claim ambiguity, each probe item must be a single, unambiguous
claim. For each flagged celebrity, we prompt Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct Grattafiori et al. (2024) to produce
atomic, pronoun-free sentences grounded in the bio, anchored on the relevant
temporal, geographical, or relational signal. Outputs containing fewer than four words or unresolved pronouns are
discarded during post-processing; full filtering criteria are provided
in Appendix D .

blocks.en:
Controlled Negative Generation. A balanced binary probe requires
plausible incorrect counterparts; implausible negatives would let models exploit
surface cues rather than genuine reasoning. We generate negatives automatically
using deterministic, category-specific perturbations. For temporal facts,
the year is shifted by a non-zero offset in [ − 10 , + 10 ] [-10,+10] , clamped to a plausible
four-digit range. For geographical facts, named-entity recognition
identifies country, city, and nationality spans, each swapped with a same-type
candidate drawn from typed pools over the full knowledge base, excluding the
celebrity’s own country. For relational facts, we apply two strategies
with equal probability: (1) a relation-word swap using a hand-built map
( married to → \to divorced from , son of → \to father of , etc.); and (2) an entity swap , replacing person or organization spans with a random same-type knowledge-base entity, never the celebrity themselves. Celebrities with no valid negative are discarded, keeping balanced labels.

blocks.en: Speech Synthesis. To isolate the effect of the audio modality from confounds such as speaker variation, all claims are synthesized using the Coqui TTS engine with the tacotron2-DDC vocoder Shen et al. (2018) , producing natural-sounding audio with consistent pronunciation and intonation. A single-speaker model is used deliberately to prevent models from exploiting speaker identity as a spurious verification cue.
blocks.zh: 语音综合. 为了将音频模式的效果从扬声器变异等混乱中分离出来,所有主张都使用Coqui TTS引擎与tacotron2-DDC vocoder Shen等人(2018年)合成,产生具有一致发音和内化的自然声学音频. 使用单声道模型是为了防止模型利用扬声器身份作为虚假的验证提示.

blocks.en:
Probe Composition. The resulting VeriSpeak probe set comprises 3,879 items spanning three fact categories (year: 1,451; location: 2,226; relation: 202), each with a balanced split of correct and incorrect claims. Each item includes: (1) the audio file, (2) an automatic transcript generated by Wav2Vec 2.0 Baevski et al. (2020) , and (3) the ground-truth veracity label. To reflect realistic deployment conditions, we use automatic transcripts
despite the resulting transcription errors. Although this increases probe difficulty, it ensures observed failures genuinely reflect multimodal reasoning limitations rather than artifacts of perfect input.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , we evaluate speech-capable Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) from three model families: Qwen-7B Bai et al. (2023) , Qwen2.5-7B Yang et al. (2024) , and Phi-4-mini-instruct Abouelenin et al. (2025) . The Qwen family includes Qwen-Audio-Chat Chu et al. (2023) and Qwen2-Audio-7B Chu et al. (2024) ; Qwen2.5 includes Audio-Flamingo-3 Ghosh et al. (2025) ; and Phi includes Phi-4-multimodal Abouelenin et al. (2025) . For each LALM, we use its associated text-only LLM backbone as a reference. This pairing lets us test whether factual verification ability observed in the text backbone remains accessible when the same claims are given as speech. We evaluate each LALM with both text and speech inputs to separate text-mode performance from speech-input degradation. We also evaluate Audio-Flamingo-next-think Ghosh et al. (2026) to examine whether explicit reasoning improves speech-based fact verification.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,我们从三个模范家庭评估具有语音能力的大型音频语言模型: 文7B号 Bai等人(2023年), Quen2.5-7B 杨等人(2024年),以及Phi-4-mini-instruct Abouellenin等人(2025年). Quen家族包括Quen-Audio-Chat Chu等人(2023年)和Qune2-Audio-7B Chu等人(2024年);Qune2.5包括Audio-Flamingo-3 Ghosh等人(2025年);Phi包括Phi-4-Multimate Abouellenin等人(2025年). 对于每个LALM,我们使用其相关的文本只LLM主干线作为参考. 这一配对使我们可以检验在文字主干中观察到的事实核查能力在作为发言提出同样主张时是否仍然可以使用。 我们用文字和语音投入来评估每个LALM, 将文本模式的性能与语音输入的退化分开。 我们还评估Audio-Flamingo-next-think Ghosh等人(2026年),以审查明确推理是否改善基于言论的事实核查。

blocks.en: We evaluate each model under controlled conditions that vary the input modality, the model interface, the availability of retrieved evidence, and the use of explicit reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们在控制条件下对每个模型进行评估,这些条件会改变输入模式,模型接口,获取证据的可用性,以及使用明确的推理.

blocks.en: Text-LLM ( 𝐓 LLM \mathbf{T}_{\mathrm{LLM}} ; C0) evaluates the text-only LLM on the written claim. This is the reference condition for factual verification in the backbone’s native text modality.
blocks.zh: Text-LLM (TLLM\mathbf{T}_{\mathrm{LLM}}; C0) 在书面索赔上评价仅文本的LLM. 这是主干线本地文本模式中事实核查的参考条件。

blocks.en: Text-LALM ( 𝐓 LALM \mathbf{T}_{\mathrm{LALM}} ; C1) evaluates the LALM on the same written claim. This condition tests whether the LALM preserves the text-side verification ability of its associated LLM backbone.
blocks.zh: Text-LALM (T LALM \ mathbf{T}_{\mathrm{LALM}}; C1) 在同一书面索赔中评价LALM. 这个条件测试LALM是否保留其相关LLM主干线的文本侧校验能力.

blocks.en: Speech-LALM ( 𝐒 LALM \mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{LALM}} ; C2) evaluates the LALM on the spoken claim without retrieved evidence. This is the main speech fact verification.
blocks.zh: Speech-LALM (S LALM \ mathbf{S}_{\ mathrm{LALM}}; C2) 在未获取证据的情况下,对口头索赔的LALM进行评估. 这是主要的语音事实验证。

blocks.en: Speech-LALM-CoT ( 𝐒 LALM ​ [ CoT ] \mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{LALM}}[\textsc{CoT}] ; C3) evaluates the LALM on the spoken claim with chain-of-thought prompting, but without retrieved evidence. This condition tests whether explicit reasoning helps the model verify the spoken claim before adding external context.
blocks.zh: Speech-LALM-CoT (SLALM [CoT]\mathbf{S}_{\ mathrm{LALM}[\textsc{CoT}]; C3)用思维链的提示来评价口述的LALM,但没有检索到的证据. 这个条件检验明示推理是否有助于模型在添加外部上下文之前验证口述说法.

blocks.en: Transcript-RAG ( 𝐒 LALM 𝐫 text \mathbf{S}^{\mathbf{r}_{\text{text}}}_{\text{LALM}} ; C4) evaluates the LALM on the spoken claim together with textual evidence retrieved using the claim transcript. Prior work has shown the benefit of external knowledge for multimodal reasoning across visual Gatti et al. (2022) ; Penamakuri and Mishra (2024) and audio Penamakuri et al. (2025) settings; here, we study its role in spoken fact verification. Figure 3 illustrates this pipeline: retrieval is performed using the ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) transcript, while the spoken claim remains the input to be verified. Specifically, the audio claim is first transcribed using wav2vec 2.0 Baevski et al. (2020) , and the resulting transcript is used to retrieve textual evidence from the knowledge base. We use multi-e5 Wang et al. (2024) as the default retriever. To test sensitivity to retriever choice, we additionally evaluate e5-large-v2 Wang et al. (2022) and msmarco-MiniLM-L12-v3 Reimers and Gurevych (2019) .
blocks.zh: Transcript-RAG (S LALM r text \ mathbf{ S}^{\mathbf{r}_{\text {text {LALM}}; C4) 将LALM与使用索赔笔录获取的文本证据一起评价口述索赔. 先前的研究表明,外部知识有助于多模式推理,跨越视觉Gatti等人(2022年);Penamakuri和Mishra(2024年)以及音频Penamakuri等人(2025年)的设置;在这方面,我们研究其在口头事实核实中的作用。 图3说明了这一管道:检索使用ASR(自动语音识别)记录,而口头索赔仍然是有待核实的投入。 具体地说,音频主张最早是使用wav2vec 2.0 Baevski等人(2020年)转录的,由此产生的记录稿用于从知识库中检索文字证据. 我们使用多e5 Wang et al. (2024)作为默认检索器. 为了测试检索器选择的敏感性,我们额外评价e5-大V2 Wang等人(2022)和msmarco-MiniLM-L12-v3 Reimers和Gurevich(2019).

blocks.en: Transcript-RAG-CoT ( 𝐒 LALM 𝐫 text ​ [ CoT ] \mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{LALM}}^{\mathbf{r}_{\mathrm{text}}}[\textsc{CoT}] ; C5) evaluates the same transcript-based RAG condition with chain-of-thought prompting. This condition tests whether explicit reasoning helps the model leverage retrieved evidence while keeping the spoken claim as the object of verification.
blocks.zh: Transcript-RAG-CoT(S LALM r text [CoT]\mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{LALM}}^{\mathrbf{r}_{\mathrm{text}}}}[\textsc{CoT}];C5)用思维链提示来评价相同的基于记录的RAG条件. 这一条件检验了明确推理是否有助于模型利用收回的证据,同时将口头主张作为核查对象。

blocks.en: We also evaluate an audio-query retrieval variant, AudioQuery-RAG ( 𝐒 LALM 𝐫 audio \mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{LALM}}^{\mathbf{r}_{\mathrm{audio}}} ), where the audio claim itself is used as the retrieval query. We use a CLAP audio-text retriever Elizalde et al. (2023) that maps audio queries and textual evidence into a shared embedding space.

blocks.zh: 5. 研究问题

blocks.en: Using the setup described previously, we now study the following research questions.
blocks.zh: 利用前述的设置,我们现在研究以下研究问题.

blocks.en: RQ1. Does factual verification transfer reliably from text to speech?
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2017-03-03). RQ1. 事实核查是否可靠地从文字转移到言论?

blocks.en: Test. We compare the text-only reference setting 𝐓 LLM \mathbf{T}_{\mathrm{LLM}} with the speech-only LALM setting 𝐒 LALM \mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{LALM}} across model families and factual categories. In Table 2 , this corresponds to comparing the rows without retrieval and without CoT prompting.

blocks.en: Finding. No. LALMs show a large and consistent modality gap. Qwen-7B achieves 75.3% accuracy in the text-only setting, while Qwen-Audio-Chat and Qwen2-Audio-7B reach only 50.4% and 49.2% in the speech-only setting, corresponding to Δ \Delta values of 24.9 and 26.1 points. Audio-Flamingo-3 drops from 71.8% to 58.5%, yielding a 13.3 point gap, and Phi-4-multimodal drops from 68.0% to 49.2%, yielding an 18.8 point gap.

blocks.en: The gap appears across all model families, indicating that factual verification behavior available in text does not reliably transfer when the same claims are presented as speech. This suggests a speech-side knowledge accessibility problem: the relevant factual knowledge may be available to the model family, but it is not consistently activated through the speech interface.
blocks.zh: 在所有模范家族中都出现了这一差距,表明文本中的事实核实行为在以口头形式提出相同主张时无法可靠地转移。 这表明语音侧面知识的可获取性问题:模型家族可能掌握相关的事实知识,但通过语音界面无法持续激活.

In Table 2 , Qwen-Audio-Chat and Audio-Flamingo-3 have positive Δ text \Delta_{\mathrm{text}} values of 9.7 and 6.8 points, respectively, indicating lower text-mode performance than their reference LLMs. This suggests that multimodal adaptation may degrade text-side factual verification ability. blocks.en: However, all models drop when the same LALM receives speech instead of text. The Δ speech \Delta_{\mathrm{speech}} values are 15.2 points for Qwen-Audio-Chat, 27.2 points for Qwen2-Audio-7B, 6.5 points for Audio-Flamingo-3, and 23.2 points for Phi-4-multimodal. This shows that the modality gap is not simply a uniform loss of text-mode factual ability after multimodal adaptation. A major source of degradation is the speech interface itself: the LALM often fails to elicit the same factual verification behavior from spoken claims that it can produce from written claims.
blocks.zh: 然而,当同一个LALM收到语音而不是文本时,所有模型都会下降. QQ语音\Delta_{\mathrm{speech}} 值为 Quen-Audio-Chat的15.2分, Qune2-Audio-7B的27.2分, Audio-Flamingo-3的6.5分, Phi-4-多模式的23.2分. 这表明,模式差距并不仅仅是在多式联运适应后统一失去文本模式的事实能力。 退化的一个主要来源是语音界面本身:LALM经常无法从口头诉求中得出它能从书面诉求中产生的同样的事实核实行为.

blocks.en: RQ3. Can retrieval compensate for the text-speech modality gap?
blocks.zh: RQ3(英语:RQ3. 检索能否弥补文本表达模式的空白?

blocks.en:
Test. Motivated by the speech-input degradation observed in RQ2, we compare the speech-only condition 𝐒 LALM \mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{LALM}} with two retrieval-augmented conditions: Transcript-RAG 𝐒 LALM 𝐫 text \mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{LALM}}^{\mathbf{r}_{\mathrm{text}}} and AudioQuery-RAG 𝐒 LALM 𝐫 audio \mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{LALM}}^{\mathbf{r}_{\mathrm{audio}}} . Table 3 reports category-level accuracy, average accuracy, L ​ i ​ f ​ t Lift , and Δ \Delta for these settings.
If retrieval compensates for the text-speech modality gap, we expect high positive L ​ i ​ f ​ t Lift and a substantially reduced Δ \Delta .
blocks.zh:
基于 RQ2 中观察到的语音输入降解的动机, 我们比较了仅语音条件 S LALM\ mathbf{ S}_{\ mathrm{ LALM} 与两个检索条件: Transscript-RAG S LALM r text\mathbf{ S}_{\ mathrm{ r}_{\ mathrm{ text} 和 AudioQuery-RAG S LALM r audio\ mathbf{ S}_{\ mathrm{ LALLM} mathb{r}_{\ mathrm{audio} 。 表3报告了类别级的准确性、平均准确性、L i f t 升降,以及这些设置的\\ Delta。
如果检索弥补了文字表达模式的空隙,我们期望高正 L i f t 升降和大幅降低 \\ Delta 。

blocks.en: Finding. Retrieval helps, but only partially. As shown in Table 3 , Transcript-RAG with multi-e5 improves all standard LALMs over their speech-only baselines: Qwen-Audio-Chat improves from 50.4% to 51.8%, Qwen2-Audio-7B from 49.2% to 50.9%, Audio-Flamingo-3 from 58.5% to 60.0%, and Phi-4-multimodal from 49.2% to 53.9%. However, these gains are modest: L ​ i ​ f ​ t Lift ranges from 1.4 to 4.7 points and averages only 2.3 points across standard LALMs.
blocks.zh: 寻找 检索有帮助,但只是部分。 如表3所示,具有多e5的Transcript-RAG改进了所有标准LALM,高于其仅言的基线:Quen-Audio-Chat改进了50.4%至51.8%,Qune2-Audio-7B改进了49.2%至50.9%,Audio-Flamingo-3改进了58.5%至60.0%,Phi-4-多式联运改进了49.2%至53.9%。 然而,这些增益并不大:L i f t 升分从1.4到4.7分不等,标准LALM平均只有2.3分.

blocks.en: The remaining gaps to the text-only baseline are still large. After Transcript-RAG , Δ \Delta remains 23.5 points for Qwen-Audio-Chat, 24.4 for Qwen2-Audio-7B, 11.8 for Audio-Flamingo-3, and 14.1 for Phi-4-multimodal. Thus, transcript-based retrieval improves speech fact verification, but does not close the text-speech modality gap.
blocks.zh: 仅文本基线的剩余缺口仍然很大。 在Transcript-RAG之后,\\Delta仍为Qwen-Audio-Chat的23.5分,24.4为Qwen2-Audio-7B,11.8为Audio-Flamingo-3,14.1为Phi-4-多式联运. 因此,基于语录的检索可以改善语音事实的验证,但不能弥补文本语音模式的空白.

blocks.en: Retriever analysis. Table 4 further compares retrieval choices. Among transcript-based retrievers, multi-e5 is the most reliable overall, although msmarco performs best for Qwen-Audio-Chat. In contrast, AudioQuery-RAG with CLAP is weaker for standard LALMs: its average L ​ i ​ f ​ t Lift is − 0.3 -0.3 points, compared with + 2.3 +2.3 for transcript-RAG with multi-e5 in Table 3 . This is consistent with CLAP’s low Recall@1 of approximately 0.3%, meaning that the top-ranked passage often fails to provide the relevant evidence.
blocks.zh: 检索分析. 表4进一步比较了检索选择。 在基于笔录的检索器中,多e5是总体最可靠的,虽然MSmarco对Quen-Audio-Chat的表现最好. 相比之下,带CLAP的AudioQuery-RAG对标准的LALM比较弱:其Li f t升降的平均值为−0.3-0.3分,而表3中为多e5的Trew-RAG为+2.3+2.3. 这与CLAP的低调回调@1大约0.3%一致,这意味着排名最高的通道往往无法提供相关证据.

blocks.en: Overall, retrieval alone is insufficient for standard LALMs. The bottleneck is not only evidence availability or retrieval quality, but also the model’s ability to reason over the spoken claim and the retrieved context. We therefore next ask whether explicit reasoning improves speech fact verification before studying reasoning in the retrieval-augmented setting.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,单靠检索不足以用于标准的LALM. 瓶颈不仅在于证据的可得性或检索质量,而且在于模型是否有能力对口述主张和检索上下文进行解释。 因此,我们接下来要问的是,在研究检索强化环境中的推理之前,明确推理是否改善了语音事实的核实。

blocks.en: Diagnostic Analysis. To understand why standard RAG yields only limited gains, we test whether retrieved evidence changes the model’s perceived object of verification. We sample 50 Qwen2-Audio-7B-Instruct Transcript-RAG examples (from the factually incorrect sample pool) and ask the model, given the spoken claim and retrieved evidence, to extract the claim to be fact-checked. These extracted claims are manually labeled as matching the spoken claim, the retrieved evidence, or other/ambiguous.
blocks.zh: 诊断分析。 为了了解为什么标准RAG只产生有限的收益,我们测试所收集的证据是否改变了模型的预期核查对象。 我们抽样50个Qune2-Audio-7B-Instruct Transcript-RAG实例(从事实上不正确的样本库),请模型,考虑到口头申诉和收集的证据,提取索赔要求,以便核实事实。 这些提取的索赔是手动标注,与口头索赔、收回的证据或其他/含糊不清的索赔相匹配。

blocks.en: Finding. RAG often shifts verification away from the spoken claim. Only 31% of extracted claims match the original claim, while 65% match the retrieved evidence, with the remaining 4% under other/ambiguous. Thus, the model more often treats the retrieved passage as the claim rather than as evidence and returns ‘Yes’. This explains the limited RAG gains in RQ3: even when relevant evidence is retrieved, the LALM fails to preserve the spoken claim as the verification target and compare it against the evidence. When it instead verifies the retrieved text itself, retrieval cannot help.
blocks.zh: 寻找 RAG经常将核查从口头主张中转移。 所提取的索赔中只有31%与原索赔相符,而65%与所取证据相符,其余4%与其他/矛盾相符合。 因此,该模型更经常地将收回的段落视为索赔,而不是证据和返回 " 是 " 。 这解释了RAG在RQ3中收益有限的原因:即使获取了相关证据,LALM也没有将口头主张保留为核实目标,并与证据进行比较. 当它验证了检索到的文本本身时,检索便无济于事.

blocks.en: RQ4. Does chain-of-thought prompting improve speech-only fact verification?
blocks.zh: RQ4(英语:RQ4. 思考链是否促使改进只言不讳的事实核查?

blocks.en: Test. We compare C2, the speech-only condition 𝐒 LALM \mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{LALM}} , with C3, its chain-of-thought variant 𝐒 LALM ​ [ CoT ] \mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{LALM}}[\textsc{CoT}] . This tests whether explicit reasoning helps the LALM verify the spoken claim without any retrieved evidence.
blocks.zh: 测试 我们比较了 C2, 语音唯一的条件 S LALM\ mathbf{ S}_{\ mathrm{ LALM} , 与 C3, 其思维链变体 S LALM [CoT]\ mathbf{ S}_{\ mathrm{ LALM} [\textsc{ CoT} 。 这种检验是否明确推理有助于LALM在没有任何检索证据的情况下核实口头申诉。

blocks.en: Finding. No. CoT alone does not improve speech-only verification for standard LALMs. As shown in Table 2 , C3 performs worse than C2 for all models: Qwen-Audio-Chat drops from 50.4% to 44.9%, Qwen2-Audio-7B from 49.2% to 44.4%, Audio-Flamingo-3 from 58.5% to 57.0%, and Phi-4-multimodal from 49.2% to 16.7% (Phi-4-multimodal’s low C3 result is caused by format failure: only 29.8% of outputs contain a parseable verdict. Full diagnostics are in Appendix B ). Correspondingly, the average Δ \Delta increases from 20.8 to 31.9 points across models, indicating that CoT moves the models farther from their text-only baselines.
blocks.zh: 寻找 不,单靠CoT并不能改进标准LALM的仅言唯语核查. 如表2所示,所有型号的C3性能都比C2差: Quen-Audio-Chat从50.4%下降到44.9%,Qune2-Audio-7B从49.2%下降到44.4%,Audio-Flamingo-3从58.5%下降到57.0%,Phi-4-多式联运从49.2%下降到16.7%(Phi-4-Multimate的低C3结果是由格式故障造成的:只有29.8%的产出包含可解析的判决. 全面诊断载于附录B。 相应的,平均QQ\Delta跨模型从20.8点增加到31.9点,表明CoT将模型移动得更远于其仅文本基线.

blocks.en: Thus, simply asking a standard LALM to reason step by step is not enough to recover factual verification ability from speech. Without external evidence, CoT can even destabilize the verification decision. This motivates the next question: whether reasoning becomes useful when the model is given retrieved evidence to reason over.
blocks.zh: 因此,仅仅要求一个标准的LALM一步一步地说明理由并不足以从言论中恢复事实核查能力。 没有外部证据,COT甚至可以动摇核查决定. 这引发了下一个问题:当模型被取回证据以说明理由时,推理是否变得有用.

blocks.en: RQ5. Does explicit reasoning help LALMs leverage retrieved evidence for verification?
blocks.zh: RQ5 (英语). 明确推理是否有助于LALMs利用检索的证据进行核查?

blocks.en: Test. We compare C4, Transcript-RAG 𝐒 LALM 𝐫 text \mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{LALM}}^{\mathbf{r}_{\mathrm{text}}} , with C5, Transcript-RAG-CoT 𝐒 LALM 𝐫 text ​ [ CoT ] \mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{LALM}}^{\mathbf{r}_{\mathrm{text}}}[\textsc{CoT}] . This tests whether CoT helps the model use retrieved textual evidence to verify the spoken claim.
blocks.zh: 测试。 我们比较了 C4, Transcript-RAG S LALM r text \ mathbf{S}_{\ mathrm {LALM}}^{\ mathrmbbf r}_{\ mathrm{ text}}}, 与 C5, Transcript-RAG- CoT S LALM r text [CoT]\ mathbf{S}_{\ mathrm{ mathbff{r}_{\ mathrm{ text}}} [\textsc{CoT} 。 这检验了CoT是否帮助模型使用检索到的文字证据来验证口述说法.

blocks.en: Finding. Yes. Unlike CoT alone, CoT with retrieval consistently improves performance. In Table 2 , C5 improves over C4 for every standard LALM: Qwen-Audio-Chat improves from 51.8% to 52.8%, Qwen2-Audio-7B from 50.9% to 57.0%, Audio-Flamingo-3 from 60.0% to 65.5%, and Phi-4-multimodal from 53.9% to 60.7%. On average, adding CoT to Transcript-RAG improves accuracy by 4.9 points.
blocks.zh: 寻找 对 与COT单独不同的是,具有检索功能的COT持续改善性能. 在表2中,C5在每一个标准的LALM中比C4有所改善:Quen-Audio-Chat从51.8%提高到52.8%,Qune2-Audio-7B从50.9%提高到57.0%,Audio-Flamingo-3从60.0%提高到65.5%,Phi-4-多式联运从53.9%提高到60.7%。 平均而言,在Transcript-RAG中加入COT使精度提高了4.9分.

blocks.en: The same trend appears in the main Δ \Delta metric. C5 reduces the remaining gap to the text-only baseline from 23.5 to 22.5 points for Qwen-Audio-Chat, from 24.4 to 18.3 points for Qwen2-Audio-7B, from 11.8 to 6.3 points for Audio-Flamingo-3, and from 14.1 to 7.3 points for Phi-4-multimodal. Averaged across models, CoT reduces Δ \Delta by 4.9 points when retrieval is present.
blocks.zh: 相同趋势出现在主要\\\Delta 度量衡中。 C5将仅文本基准的剩余差距从23.5点减少到22.5点,Quen-Audio-Chat从24.4点减少到18.3点,Qune2-Audio-7B从11.8点减少到6.3点,Phi-4-多式从14.1点减少到7.3点. 平均跨模型,当存在检索时,CoT将QQ\Delta减少4.9点.

blocks.en: This contrast between RQ4 and RQ5 is central: CoT alone does not help speech-only verification, but CoT helps once retrieved evidence is available. This suggests that explicit reasoning is most useful for claim–evidence comparison, not for recovering factual knowledge from speech alone. In other words, reasoning helps the LALM leverage retrieved evidence for the correct purpose: verifying the spoken claim rather than treating the retrieved text as the claim itself.
blocks.zh: 这种RQ4和RQ5之间的对比是中心:单靠CoT并不能帮助只进行语音验证,但CoT一旦可以获取证据,就会有所帮助. 这表明,明确推理对索赔-证据比较最有用,而不是仅仅从言论中收回事实知识。 换句话说,推理有助于LALM为正确目的利用所检索的证据:核实口头索赔,而不是将所检索的案文作为索赔本身。

blocks.en: Table 5: Comparison between a standard LALM (AF-3) and a thinking-tuned LALM (AF-next-think).
blocks.zh: 表5:标准LALM(AF-3)与思维调整的LALM(AF-next-think)的比较.

blocks.en: RQ6. Do thinking-tuned LALMs make retrieval more effective for speech fact verification?
blocks.zh: RQ6(英语:RQ6. 思考的LALM是否使检索对语音事实的验证更加有效?

blocks.en: Test. We compare a standard LALM, Audio-Flamingo-3, with a thinking-tuned LALM, Audio-Flamingo-next-think, under the same four speech settings: C2 ( 𝐒 LALM \mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{LALM}} ), C3 ( 𝐒 LALM ​ [ CoT ] \mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{LALM}}[\textsc{CoT}] ), C4 ( 𝐒 LALM 𝐫 text \mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{LALM}}^{\mathbf{r}_{\mathrm{text}}} ), and C5 ( 𝐒 LALM 𝐫 text ​ [ CoT ] \mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{LALM}}^{\mathbf{r}_{\mathrm{text}}}[\textsc{CoT}] ). This comparison separates inference-time CoT prompting from model-level thinking ability. We report L ​ i ​ f ​ t Lift from C2 to C5, the remaining gap Δ \Delta to the Qwen2.5-7B text-only baseline, and the upper-bound gap: Δ UB = A ⁡ ( 𝐓 LLM 𝐫 text ) − A ⁡ ( C5 ) . \Delta_{\mathrm{UB}}=A(\mathbf{T}_{\mathrm{LLM}}^{\mathbf{r}_{\mathrm{text}}})-A(\mathrm{C5}).
blocks.zh: 测试 我们比较一个标准的LALM, Audio-Flamingo-3, 与一个经过思维调制的LALM, Audio-Flamingo-next-thind-thinese, 在同一四个语音设置下: C2(S LALM\mathbf{S}_{\mathrm{LALM}), C3(S LALM [CoT]\mathb{S}_{\mathrm{LAT} [\textsc{CT}), C4(S LALM r}_{\mathrm{LALAM{LAM{LAM{LAM{T}), C4(S LALM r}_{\mathrm{text{[\text{COT})). 这种比较将推论时间COT提示与模型级思维能力区分开来. 我们报告 L i f t 从 C2 升至 C5 升空, 剩余空白 \\ Delta 到 Qwen2.5-7B 文本唯一的基线, 以及上方的空白 :\ UB = A = A {( T LLM r 文本 ) → A {( C5 ) 。\ Delta { mathhrm{ UB} A(\ mathb{ mathrm{ text}) 。

blocks.en: Finding. Yes. Table 5 shows that the thinking-tuned model benefits from reasoning and retrieval much more strongly than the standard model. For standard Audio-Flamingo-3, vanilla CoT does not help: C3 drops slightly below C2, from 58.5% to 57.0%. Retrieval alone improves performance to 60.0%, and RAG+CoT reaches 65.5%, giving a L ​ i ​ f ​ t Lift of 7.0 points from C2 to C5.
blocks.zh: 寻找 对 表5显示,经过思考调整的模型比标准模型更能从推理和检索中获益。 对于标准的Audio-Flamingo-3,香草CoT无济于事:C3略低于C2,从58.5%下降到57.0%. 单是检索就可以提高性能到60.0%,RAG+CoT达到65.5%,给一个L i f t升降从C2到C5的7.0分.

blocks.en: In contrast, Audio-Flamingo-next-think shows gains at every step. Vanilla CoT already improves speech-only verification from 66.4% to 71.8%, unlike the pattern observed for standard LALMs in RQ4. Transcript-RAG further improves performance to 81.4%, and RAG+CoT reaches 86.1%, giving a much larger L ​ i ​ f ​ t Lift of 19.7 points from C2 to C5. Further, on Δ \Delta , Audio-Flamingo-next-think with C5 exceeds the text-only baseline by 14.3 points, giving a negative Δ \Delta . This means that, once retrieval and CoT are combined with a thinking-tuned LALM, speech-based verification can outperform the non-retrieval text-only baseline. However, the model remains 6.3 points below the text-only RAG upper bound 𝐓 LLM 𝐫 text \mathbf{T}_{\mathrm{LLM}}^{\mathbf{r}_{\mathrm{text}}} , showing that there is still a measurable gap between speech-based RAG and fully text-based RAG.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,Audio-Flamingo-next-think显示每个步骤都有收获. Vanilla CoT已经改进了仅语音验证,从66.4%提高到71.8%,与RQ4中标准LALM观察到的模式不同. Transcript-RAG进一步提高性能至81.4%,RAG+CoT达到86.1%,使L i f t 升降比从C2到C5的19.7分大得多. 此外,在\\Delta上,与C5的Audio-Flamingo-next-think 超过仅文本基线14.3分,给出负\\Delta 。 这意味着,一旦检索和CoT与思维调试的LALM结合,基于语音的验证可以超过不检索文本的基线. 然而,该模型仍然低于文本唯一的RAG上部绑定的T LLM r text\mathbf{T}_{\mathrm{LLM}}^{\matathbf{r}_{\mathrm{text}}}}的6.3点,显示基于语音的RAG和完全基于文本的RAG之间仍存在可测量的差距.

blocks.en: Overall, thinking-specific instruction tuning changes how the model benefits from both CoT and retrieval. For standard LALMs, CoT alone is unreliable and retrieval gives modest gains. For the thinking-tuned LALM, CoT improves speech-only verification, RAG provides a large additional gain, and RAG+CoT gives the strongest result. This suggests that reasoning-trained LALMs are better able to preserve the spoken claim, compare it against retrieved textual evidence, and produce a reliable verification decision.
blocks.zh: 总体来说,针对思维的教学调整会改变模型如何从CoT和检索两方面获益. 就标准的LALM而言,单是CoT是不可靠的,检索可以产生微小的收益. 对于思维调制的LALM,COT改进了语音唯一验证,RAG提供了巨大的额外收益,RAG+COT给出了最强的结果. 这表明,经过推理训练的LALM能够更好地维护口头申诉,将其与检索的文字证据相比较,并作出可靠的核查决定。

blocks.en: 6 Additional Analysis
blocks.zh: 6 其他分析

blocks.en: To distinguish speech-perception errors from downstream verification errors, we compute the word error rate (WER) between each LALM’s generated transcription and the original claim text. For year claims, we normalize equivalent numerical expressions (e.g., “2008” and “two thousand eight”) before scoring. As shown in Table 6 , overall WER ranges from 0.13 to 0.23, indicating model-specific variation in recovering the spoken content.
blocks.zh: 为了区分语音-感知错误和下游核查错误,我们计算每个LALM生成的文本与索赔原文之间的文字错误率。 对于年度索赔,我们在评分前将等值数字表示法(例如“2008年”和“2 000 8”)正常化。 如表6所示,WER的总体范围为0.13至0.23,表明在恢复口语内容方面有特定模型的变化。

blocks.en: As a human intelligibility reference, we recruited two native English speakers to transcribe 50 randomly sampled clips. Their transcriptions yielded an avg. WER of 0.105, with annotator-level WERs of 0.15 and 0.06, suggesting that the synthesized speech is generally intelligible to human listeners. To characterize the remaining model errors, we further analyze the outputs of AF-3. Approximately 74% of its WER edit operations involve subject names or other proper nouns, often reflecting spelling or phonetic variants such as “Richie/Ritchie,” “Kris/Chris,” and “Bachelet/Bachellet.” In contrast, non-name tokens have an error rate of approximately 3%. Thus, the main challenge is entity recognition rather than general audio intelligibility. This distinction is particularly important for fact verification, where names and locations are often label-critical.
blocks.zh: 作为人类知识的参考,我们招募了两名英语母语者来翻译50个随机抽样的片段。 他们的笔录产生了阴阳。 0.105的WER,其注释级WERs为0.15和0.06,暗示合成的语音一般能为人类听众所理解. 为了描述其余的模型错误,我们进一步分析AF-3的产出。 大约74%的WER编辑操作涉及主题名称或其他适当的名词,经常反映拼写或语音变体,如“Richie/Ritchie”、“Kris/Chris”、“Bachelet/Bachellet”。 相比之下,非名符体的误差率约为3%. 因此,主要的挑战在于实体承认,而不是一般的音频知识。 这种区分对于核实事实尤为重要,因为在那里,名称和地点往往具有标签重要性。

blocks.en: To estimate the downstream effect of LALMs speech-recognition errors, we add an auxiliary diagnostic condition, C0 ′ . In C0 ′ , each LALM-generated transcription is provided as text input to the same paired text LLM evaluated in C0. Thus, C0 and C0 ′ differ only in whether the LLM receives the original claim or the model-generated transcription. We define Δ recognition = A ⁡ ( C0 ) − A ⁡ ( C0 ′ ) \Delta_{\mathrm{recognition}}=A(\text{C0})-A(\text{C0}^{\prime}) as an approximate estimate of the verification degradation attributable to speech misrecognition.
blocks.zh: 为了估计LALMs语音识别错误的下游影响,我们增加了一个辅助诊断条件C0 ′. 在C0 ′中,每个 LALM 生成的转录器作为文本输入,输入C0 中评价的同配对文本 LLM. 因此,C0和C0 ' 仅在LLM收到原始索赔或模型产生的抄录方面有所不同。 我们定义 QQ 识别 = A = (C0) = A = (C0 ' )\Delta = mathrm{ 识别 = A(\text{C0})- A(\text{C0} = prime}) 是对可归因于语音错误识别的核查退化的大致估计。

blocks.en: The results show a measurable degradation, with Δ recognition \Delta_{\mathrm{recognition}} ranging from 5.6 to 11.6 points across models. This trend is broadly consistent with the WER analysis, where transcription quality varies across LALMs. However, WER alone does not fully determine verification performance, as errors affecting fact-critical information (e.g., entities, years, locations, or relations) can have a disproportionate impact on the final prediction.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 7 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We introduced VeriSpeak , a controlled benchmark for evidence-grounded fact verification in speech, containing 3,879 spoken claims across temporal, geographical, and relational facts. Our experiments show that factual verification ability in text does not reliably transfer to speech: LALMs exhibit a consistent text–speech modality gap, even when their text-side performance remains strong. We further find that retrieval alone only partially addresses this gap, since standard LALMs often conflate retrieved textual evidence with the spoken claim itself. In contrast, retrieval combined with explicit reasoning improves claim–evidence comparison, with a thinking-tuned LALM reaching 86.1% accuracy under transcript-based RAG with CoT. These results suggest that robust speech fact-checking requires not only speech recognition and evidence retrieval, but also mechanisms for preserving the spoken claim, grounding it in external evidence, and reasoning across modalities.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Verispeak(Verispeak), 用于在言语中基于证据的事实验证的控制基准, 我们的实验表明,文本中的事实核查能力不能可靠地转移到语音上: LALMs 显示一个一致的文本 - speech 模式差距, 即使其文本侧性能仍然很强. 我们进一步发现,仅检索只是部分地解决了这一差距,因为标准的LALM往往将检索到的文字证据与口头主张本身混为一谈。 与此相反,检索与明确推理相结合改进了索赔-证据的比较,在基于记录誊本的RAG和COT下,经过思维调整的LALM精确度达到86.1%。 这些结果表明,强有力的语音事实检查不仅需要语音识别和证据检索,还需要保留口述主张、以外部证据为依据和跨模式推理的机制。

blocks.en: Future Work. Looking ahead, a broader goal for speech fact-checking is to build LALMs with little or no degradation relative to strong text-only LLM baselines. Ideally, LALMs should not rely on retrieval merely to compensate for weak speech-side factual access; when the required knowledge is available, spoken claims should be verified as reliably as written ones. For open-world or time-sensitive claims, retrieval will remain necessary, but models must better preserve the spoken claim as the verification target, treat retrieved text only as evidence, and explicitly compare the two. Although the thinking-tuned model narrows the gap, reaching 86.1% with transcript-based RAG and CoT, it still trails the fully text-based RAG upper bound, leaving speech–text verification parity as an important research direction. In our future work, we aim to extend VeriSpeak to multilingual claims, diverse accents and dialects, natural speech, broader fact domains, and richer evidence sources.
blocks.zh: 未来工作。 展望未来,语音事实检查的一个更广泛的目标是建立LALM,相对于强力的文本唯一LLM基线而言,没有或几乎没有退化。 理想的情况是,LALM不应仅仅依靠检索来弥补言论方面实际访问的薄弱;在获得所需知识时,口头申诉应与书面申诉一样可靠。 对于开放世界或时间敏感的索赔,仍然需要检索,但模型必须更好地将口头索赔保留为核查目标,只将检索的文字作为证据,并明确比较两者。 虽然思维调整模型缩小了差距,在基于文字的RAG和CoT中达到了86.1%,但它仍然跟随了完全基于文字的RAG上方约束,留下了语音-文本验证等同作为重要的研究方向. 在我们今后的工作中,我们的目标是将Verispeak扩展至多种语言的权利主张、不同的口音和方言、自然的言论、更广泛的事实领域和丰富的证据来源。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: VeriSpeak is designed as a controlled probe benchmark, and its limitations largely follow from this design choice. The benchmark focuses on temporal, geographical, and relational facts from celebrity biographies, enabling controlled analysis across fact types but leaving broader claim types such as scientific, medical, numerical, causal, and multi-hop claims for future work. The spoken claims are synthesized with a single-speaker TTS system to isolate the effect of input modality, which means the benchmark does not capture spontaneous speech, background noise, diverse accents, dialects, or multilingual speech. Retrieval is also performed over a fixed evidence collection to support controlled claim–evidence comparisons, rather than over noisy, conflicting, or time-sensitive open-world sources. More broadly, speech-based fact verification remains a largely open direction in speech NLP, and these limitations point to several important avenues for future research.
blocks.zh: Verispeak被设计为可控探测器基准,其局限性主要来自于这种设计选择. 该基准侧重于名人传记中的时间、地理和关系事实,从而能够对事实类型进行有控制的分析,但将更广泛的索赔类型,如科学、医疗、数字、因果和多重索赔留给今后的工作。 口语主张用单语TTS系统合成,以隔离输入模式的效果,这意味着基准不捕捉自发的语音,背景噪音,多种口音,方言,或多语种语音. 检索工作也通过固定证据收集进行,以支持控制下的索赔-证据比较,而不是过于吵闹、冲突或时间敏感的开放世界来源。 更广泛地说,基于言论的事实核查在语言NLP方面仍然在很大程度上是一个开放的方向,这些局限性指明了未来研究的几个重要途径.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: VeriSpeak is derived from the publicly available KVQA knowledge base, which contains public-figure information sourced from Wikidata, and does not include private or user-provided personal data. The benchmark contains synthetic false claims solely for controlled evaluation; each claim is paired with a veracity label and clearly identified as benchmark-generated in the dataset documentation and metadata. VeriSpeak is intended for evaluating speech-based fact-verification systems and should not be treated as a source of factual claims about individuals.
blocks.zh: Verispeak来源于公开的KVQA知识库,该知识库包含来自Wikidata的公有图信息,不包括私人或用户提供的个人数据. 该基准包含仅用于受控评估的合成虚假索赔;每项索赔均附有真实性标签,并明确列为数据集文件和元数据中生成的基准。 Verispeak旨在评价基于语音的事实核查系统,不应作为对个人提出实际主张的来源。

blocks.en: Fact type. The benefit of retrieval and reasoning is consistent across all fact categories, but not uniform. blocks.en: Takeaway. The stratified results show that Transcript-RAG+CoT improves speech fact verification broadly, but the gains are not uniform. Fact type is the strongest source of variation: temporal facts benefit most from retrieval and reasoning, while relational facts remain the hardest, likely because they require preserving entity roles and relation direction. Gender effects are comparatively small. Male-subject claims receive slightly larger absolute gains, but this does not translate into a smaller modality gap because text-only baselines are also stronger on this slice. Country-level results show clearer differences in gap closure: US-subject claims benefit most, with both the largest L ​ i ​ f ​ t Lift and the smallest remaining Δ \Delta , whereas England and India retain larger gaps despite high final accuracy, and Germany receives the least absolute improvement. Overall, the dominant pattern remains model-driven: standard LALMs improve only partially, while the thinking-tuned model generalizes more reliably across factual, gender, and country slices.

blocks.en: We conduct output-level diagnostics to better understand the near- and below-random performance observed in several model–setting pairs.

We apply strict parsing: if this field is missing or does not contain a parseable verdict, the output is marked incorrect. Table 10 reports the percentage of outputs satisfying this requirement under the speech-only CoT condition C3 and the Transcript-RAG+CoT condition C5.

blocks.en: Most model–setting pairs have parseability rates above 90%. The main exception is Phi-4-multimodal under C3, for which only 29.8% of outputs are parseable. Inspection shows that the model frequently terminates after generating the <claim> field without producing the required <answer> field. Its below-random C3 accuracy therefore partly reflects format non-compliance and should not be interpreted solely as factual-verification performance. Providing retrieved evidence in C5 raises its parseability to 82.4%.

blocks.en: For the Qwen models, parseability remains approximately 99%, yet C3 does not improve over the corresponding non-CoT speech-only condition C2.
